result.markdown: --- title: "[compare()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compare multiple fitted GAMs in a summary table. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/whittaker/blob/main/whittaker/fitting/compare.py#L135-L206){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python compare(*models) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Collects AIC, BIC, deviance explained, adjusted R-squared, EDF, GCV (when available), and scale from each model, sorts by AIC, and computes delta-AIC from the best model. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [*models]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [GAM]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Two or more fitted GAM objects. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ComparisonResult]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Comparison table sorted by AIC (best first). ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If fewer than 2 models are provided. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#2319826c .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import numpy as np import whittaker as wk rng = np.random.default_rng(0) x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200) y = np.sin(x) + rng.normal(0, 0.3, 200) data = {"x": x, "y": y} m1 = wk.GAM("y ~ x").fit(data) m2 = wk.GAM("y ~ s(x, k=5)").fit(data) m3 = wk.GAM("y ~ s(x, k=15)").fit(data) print(wk.compare(m1, m2, m3)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Model Comparison (3 models, 200 observations) # Formula AIC ΔAIC BIC Dev.Expl. Adj.R² EDF GCV --- ------------------------------ ---------- -------- ---------- ---------- -------- ------- ---------- 1 y ~ s(x, k=5) 78.32 +0.00 94.67 86.7% 0.8636 5.0 0.086642 2 y ~ s(x, k=15) 79.21 +0.89 103.14 87.0% 0.8646 7.3 0.087059 3 y ~ x 332.62 +254.30 339.22 51.1% 0.5065 2.0 0.308909 ``` ::: :::
